inventory_notes: TemporalAssemblyMemory._new_candidate stores the first matched ActivityPattern as prototype; later learn-path matches update occurrences/episode_ids/last_seen/similarity_sum but do not replace prototype.
TemporalAssemblyMemory.best_match compares every incoming pattern against candidate.prototype; exact score ties are broken by lexicographically smaller assembly_id.

patterns_from_step iterates cascades in caller order and appends one ActivityPattern per cascade; it performs no final pattern sort. Its fallback path creates at most one all-spike pattern when no cascade pattern exists.

CascadeTracker.update sorts spikes by (time_ms, unit_id), finalizes on temporal gaps, and appends finalized cascades as encountered. IntegratedV05Brain passes base_result.cascades directly into patterns_from_step and iterates the returned tuple sequentially into TemporalAssemblyMemory.observe.

The supported v0.5 world canonicalizes pulse order by (time_ms, channel); reference training_episodes uses a fixed episode sequence alternating motif_x and motif_y every 220 ms. No supported training-order permutation contract was found on this surface.

THEORY_SPEC_v0.5 says Assembly formation clusters Cascade observations using participating units, ordered activity, relative timing, duration, and recurrence. This specifies order within an activity pattern, not whether the sequence in which multiple candidate patterns are presented to the online clusterer is semantically meaningful or invariant.

V05_EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL order_shuffle changes the event-symbol order inside held-out episodes. It is not a test or contract for reordering the same set of ActivityPattern observations into TemporalAssemblyMemory during learning.

No stable-main supported doc/test/callsite found in the fixed inventory declares cross-pattern candidate presentation order to be intentionally semantic, requires partition invariance to such reordering, or constructs the component Discovery's non-transitive bridge triad through the integrated v0.5 path.

Assembly partition identity is not merely presentation metadata: AssemblyPredictor counts, AssemblyActionPolicy scores/visits, suppression, evaluation purity, causal Assembly ablation, pending activation, and checkpoint state all consume/preserve assembly_id-conditioned state. A genuine partition difference could therefore alter downstream conditioned state even though this cycle does not establish supported bridge reachability.
